S1.why: Counter label in two words; ফ্রি is the word Bengali phone users say and read for no-charge, বিনামূল্যে would be stiff on a tile caption.

S2.why: An invitation in the polite আপনি imperative with the vocab item word; রাখা (to keep) is the plain verb for saving and recurs through the sheet.

S3.s: %lldটি ফ্রি কাটলিংই রাখা হয়ে গেছে। এগুলো ফ্রিই থাকবে, আর আগের মতোই কাজ করবে।
S3.back: 5-piece free cutlings-all kept have-become-gone. These free-indeed will-stay, and before like-just work will-do.
S3.why: হয়ে গেছে says used up without blame; the emphatic -ই on ফ্রিই and মতোই carries the reassurance a speaker would stress.

S4.why: States the offer as a fact, the way a Bengali shop sign would, instead of a 'you can' sentence.

S5.why: Bengali says the whole before the part (৫টির মধ্যে ৩টি), so the placeholders are positional and the free total comes first.

S6.why: A noun phrase for the bold row; no টি after a large formatted number, as Bengali writers drop the classifier on big round counts.

S7.s: সর্বোচ্চ %@টি টেক্সট আর %lldটি ছবি রাখতে পারবেন।
S7.back: Maximum 5,000-piece text and 500-piece images keep can-you.
S7.why: টেক্সট and ছবি from the vocabulary file; আর is the spoken 'and' between two things, এবং would be bookish here.

S8.why: Device names stay in Latin script as the vocabulary file writes Mac and Apple Account; ও is the everyday conjunction before the last of a list.

S9.s: এক কেনাতেই আপনার Apple Account-এর সব ডিভাইসে চলবে।
S9.back: One purchase-in-itself your Apple Account-of all devices-on will-run.
S9.why: এক কেনাতেই (in one purchase alone) carries 'covers all' through the -ই ending; Apple Account-এর hyphenated the way the vocab writes Mac-এর.

S10.why: A short noun phrase that sits beside S6 in the same shape; দাম (price) is what a buyer thinks about, not the bookish ক্রয়.

S11.s: সাবস্ক্রিপশন নেই, বিজ্ঞাপন নেই, অ্যাকাউন্ট খুলতেও হবে না।
S11.back: Subscription isn't, advertisement isn't, account open-even must not.
S11.why: The repeated নেই is how a speaker lists what is absent; the third item turns to a verb because 'no sign-up' is something you do not have to do.

S12.why: The wording Bengali-localised iOS and Android apps use for the store's restore action; kept formal because it names a system action, not app voice.

S13.why: Same noun as S12 in the progressive, ending with the single ellipsis character.

S14.why: দিয়ে (by giving) puts the price inside the action; আনলক is the loanword Bengali phone users already use for unlocking.

S16.why: The user's own 'maybe later', a deferral in the first person, polite and without any refusal in it.

S17.why: The standard Bengali label for closing a sheet or window.

S18.why: সবটুকু means the whole amount, so it takes in the room as well as the features; warm without an exclamation mark.

S19.s: ধন্যবাদ। আপনার এই কেনা কাটলিংয়ের পাশে দাঁড়াল, আর যিনি একা এটা বানান, তাঁরও।
S19.back: Thanks. Your this purchase Cutling-of beside stood, and who-one alone this makes, his-too.
S19.why: পাশে দাঁড়ানো (to stand beside) is the Bengali idiom for support; তাঁর is the honorific for the one maker.

S20.s: আবার স্বাগতম। আপনার আগের কেনাটা ফিরে এসেছে।

S21.why: Same wording as S5 so the spoken and the written count agree; positional for the whole-before-part order.

S24.why: Impersonal verb with no subject, so nobody is blamed.
